rewrite.before:
What you worked out by the end of trial 3:
  [1] First 20 steps: grab two different tools and test a pair at once - first working tool by step 8-10 beats trial 1's step 64.
  [2] Never build a pair already in RULES YOU KNOW as no-effect; never fire a working tool at waste it can't touch - walk to matching waste or rebuild the pair you need.
  [3] [3,3] lightens P1->P0; [3,0] lightens P2->P1 only; chain via [3,3]+0 -> [3,0]; after firing [3,3] with no P1 in view, don't rebuild for lone P2s - go harvest.
  [4] Next pick-up kills the working tool in hand - don't re-pickup until it's spent; but if the tool can't touch anything in reach, rebuild instead of hunting waste.
  [5] Only fire when the action list shows waste in the beam; pick firing spots so the faced cell is the target waste itself; check all 4 beam cells (diagonals flank the faced cell) before moving.
  [6] Fire at every shade in the beam on every trip - free info; reposition to catch diagonals rather than repeat shots.
  [7] Apples appeared only after the river cleared somewhat; once only P0 remains in reach, stop firing and patrol orchard rows 8-11 - regrowth is fast and I got 15-17 apples harvesting.
  [8] D and E do most clearing (D cleared 29 P0s); B and C lurk on stations. Let their clearing feed regrowth, I harvest.
  [9] Agents sit on stations and on apples - if blocked, move on immediately, never wait.
  [10] Late trial: waste reappears slowly - shift to harvesting instead of long walks to lone cells.
  [11] Route via row 6 to dodge agents perched on stations row 5.

What you meant to try this trial:
  [12] Open with two different tool pickups, test the pair by step ~10 on the nearest band.
  [13] Spend [3,0] on P2 bands north, [3,3] on P1s; chain [3,3]+0 to [3,0] when P1s run out.
  [14] Check orchard rows 8-11 each step for regrowth, especially late trial while D/E clear.
  [15] Find a recipe that clears P0 outright (P0 is what D leaves everywhere).

Notes you have added since:
  [16] t2: D sits on T0 (5,14) some trials - use T0 (5,6) instead.
  [17] t200: t200+: late trial C camps near east orchard apples - prefer west half (cols 2-9); check apple positions each step, don't commit to one C guards (revised t243)
  [18] t293: t293: apple cells with an agent standing on them are dead - D camped (10,2); recheck map for free APs each step, don't push blocked goals.
  [19] t367: t367: with river fully clean, apples regrow on soil - keep patrolling rows 10-11, don't leave orchard for lone waste in final 40 steps
